description: How a user can donate to one person: through the Power Players PAC where the law and our registrations allow (federal races, and state races in the states we are registered in), otherwise a link to the campaign's own donation page (ActBlue, WinRed, Anedot or campaign site), or none on file. throughPowerPlayers.available says whether the person can receive a donation through Power Players now; when false, throughPowerPlayers.reason says why in plain words (for example, the candidate has not connected their campaign committee's payout account yet). When the campaign page is a reviewed donation page, platform names it (actblue, winred, anedot or other) and handoffUrl is the same page with the optional amountDollars (whole dollars) and a Power Players tracking code filled in; it never carries personal details, and the user types their own details on that page. Read-only: the assistant never takes payment or submits a form; the user completes any contribution on the linked page.
name: get_donation_options
title: Get donation options
